wire.mapOrder: ascending unsigned integer keys; shortest encoding; all listed keys required

cose.container: tag18 COSE_Sign1 with exact embedded payload and P1363 signature

event.source: urn:openpc:service:<sourceId>; exact installed workload source identity, never inferred from logical service name
event.subject: urn:openpc:resource:<evidenceExportId>
event.causationId: exact retained original governed export-start outbox event ID
event.sequence: positive u64 in EVIDENCE_EXPORT_COMPLETION_V1; one immutable successful completion per export identity
event.dataPreimage: PC-CBOR-1 map with exactly 0=evidenceExportId as canonical resource URN text, 1=checkpoint as unsigned u64, 2=outputDigest as H32 bytes, 3=recordCount as unsigned u64; dataDigest=SHA256 of those bytes
event.dataJson: exact registered EvidenceExportCompleted projection; counters serialize as canonical decimal strings
event.recordedAtNs: positive u64, divisible by 1000; envelope time is the exact UTC timestamp with six fractional digits

admission.source: actual scoped control.evidence_export_request SUCCEEDED and immutable control.evidence_export_output; exact approved start operation, retained selection/request digest, final checkpoint, artifact digest and actual minimized record count
admission.identity: event ID, sequence, source identity and signing input reserved durably once by the export owner; signer or network uncertainty retains that original identity and bytes
admission.authority: separate current LS-EVIDENCE-EXPORT workload/credential, scope, purpose-bound signing grant, key lifecycle and source transaction fences; authoritySnapshotDigest and signerTrustSnapshotDigest bind retained independently verified snapshots
admission.signature: cryptographic verification is historical evidence only; no caller-supplied key, receipt, snapshot digest or decoded claim confers current producer or consumer authority
admission.commit: completed output, immutable completion receipt, evidence and exact registered event/outbox are bound by the owning SQL transaction; no CommandCommitted or LEGACY substitution; no unsigned success event
admission.privacy: only registered minimized completion metadata is emitted; no artifact contents, source records, protected payload, key material or recipient is included
admission.recovery: exact replay/readback preserves signed bytes and IDs; no fresh signing intent or output after ambiguous commit; completion does not authorize routing or delivery
